entries.brief: A warm human head silhouette sheltered beneath a compact silver-blue arched ward, a shadowy claw and ghost wisp held outside. Protective magic against supernatural beings, no weapon or alignment scales. Full-color original SKAZ fantasy handbook painted icon. Bold broad shapes, dark defined contours, warm ochre highlights, cool slate shadows, restrained glow. Compact central motif occupying only65 percent square canvas, empty transparent margin on all sides. No text, digits, border, circular background or UI. Transparent PNG.

review.notes: Local IAB32/40px, grayscale circle, Polaris/Coal/Atlas. Six distinct silhouettes inspected in all themes. Ray of Enfeeblement broadened for 32px readability; Remove Curse uses an intact ring with unravelling magic; Revivify uses diamond and returning life spark.

Short broad blunt training sword tilted downward, held loosely to express tiredness. Dark purple magical ribbon across wrist, no injuries or blood. Keep original painterly full-color style, transparent background, whole design entirely inside central65 percent canvas, wide empty margins. No text.
